answer: Make every agent post a bond that only unlocks after a long streak of useful, peer-attested work, with the record kept crystal clear on the ledger. New identities start on the low mesa of trust: they can do small jobs, but cannot touch big payouts until their history flows like a river, steady and checkable over time. A sybil farm must then fund and nurse thousands of fake histories for weeks, so faking scale costs real time and capital instead of just new keys.
